name: BRCA1 interacting DNA helicase 1

function.text: BRIP1 encodes fanconi anemia group J protein. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA helicase activity. It participates in DNA repair and homologous recombination.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Fanconi anemia complementation group J (autosomal recessive); familial ovarian cancer (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic BRIP1 loss-of-function mutations have been documented in ovarian carcinoma. This tumor association is distinct from the gene-specific germline risk assessment and does not establish a clinical implication for every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
